Container.Name: proxyseerr
Container.Overview:
A lightweight API routing proxy that lets Seerr (or Overseerr/Jellyseerr) drive two Sonarr instances through a single server connection - typically a standard English TV instance and a dedicated Anime instance set up per the TRaSH Guides.
Seerr can override a request's root folder and quality profile, but it cannot switch which Sonarr instance a request is sent to. proxyseerr sits in between: it presents one merged Sonarr API (both libraries, both root folders, both quality profiles), and routes each add, lookup, search command and queue call to the instance that actually owns it. Anime-side IDs are offset so the two instances never collide in Seerr's database.
Point Seerr's single Sonarr server at this container, pick the anime root folder or the [Anime] quality profile in a Seerr override rule, and the request lands on the anime instance.

Config.Name: Proxy Port
Config.Description: Port Seerr connects to. Use this as the Sonarr port inside Seerr.

Config.Name: English Sonarr URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your standard TV Sonarr instance. This is the default instance: anything not matched as anime goes here.

Config.Name: English Sonarr API Key
Config.Description: API key from the standard TV Sonarr (Settings - General - Security).

Config.Name: Anime Sonarr URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your dedicated Anime Sonarr instance.

Config.Name: Anime Sonarr API Key
Config.Description: API key from the Anime Sonarr instance.

Config.Name: Proxy API Key
Config.Description: Optional. If set, the proxy only accepts requests carrying this key - enter the same value as the API key in Seerr's Sonarr settings. Leave blank to accept any caller (fine on a trusted LAN).

Config.Name: Anime Root Folder Match
Config.Description: Fallback keyword. If a request's root folder path contains this string and the path is not owned by a known instance, it is routed to the anime instance.

Config.Name: Anime Label Prefix
Config.Description: Prefix added to anime quality/language profile names so they are distinguishable in Seerr's dropdowns.

Config.Name: Anime ID Offset
Config.Description: Amount anime-side IDs are shifted by so the two instances share one ID space. Only change this before adding anything through the proxy - changing it later invalidates the IDs already stored in Seerr.

Config.Name: Upstream Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for a Sonarr instance before giving up.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR. INFO logs one line per routing decision.
